readout_other: 3-back working memory task (accuracy, d'); BAI; BDI; MAIA-2; side effects questionnaire
direction_notes: Active taVNS across both modalities improved d' from pre to post, but the U-taVNS-specific active vs sham contrast was not significant and sham U-taVNS showed a similar trend.
safety_notes: Side-effect questionnaire after each session; in the U-taVNS group 3.4% reported skin irritation and 10.3% ear pain.

timing.protocol_description: Single 30 minute session of ultrasound taVNS to the right cymba conchae (41 Hz PRF, 50% duty cycle), before and after which a 3-back task was performed; active and sham sessions at least five days apart, order counterbalanced.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Fifty-nine healthy adults (46 females and 13 males; Mean age = 23.6 years, SD = 2.88) were recruited and randomly allocated to either the E-taVNS group (n = 30) or the U-taVNS group (n = 29).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each participant completed two sessions: one active stimulation session and one sham session, separated by at least five days (mean = 11.68, SD = 11.90).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The transducer was coupled with water-based acoustic conductive gel, applied between the ultrasound transducer and the cymba conchae to reduce interfacial air and optimize the transmission of ultrasonic waves. The system parameters included a 5.3 MHz center frequency, 41 Hz pulse repetition frequency, 50% duty cycle, peak mechanical output of 0.081 W/cm<sup>2</sup>, and average intensity (free-field peak pressure) of 1.03 MPa.
